$comment: Hand-maintained facts for the third-party list of the info view (scripts/notices/generate.ts reads this file, third_party/manifest.json, package.json, the lockfiles and the licence files of the real components). Everything that can be read from a real file is read from it; only purposes, groups, display labels and the few facts that no file holds (and that the generator cross-checks where it can) are written here. Change a version of Electron, Velopack or the Visual C++ runtime and the check fails until the matching value here is confirmed.

npm.$comment: Packages of package.json 'dependencies' (and their dependencies) must each belong to an entry below or be listed in notBundled with the reason. extraRoots are devDependencies whose code ends up in the bundle (and whose own dependencies are then shipped too). scripts/notices/verify-bundle.ts proves both against a real production build.

notBundled.tslib: Dependency of motion and framer-motion; no module of it is part of the production bundle (checked against the real build).

note.de: HalfCube nutzt Open CASCADE Technology (OCCT) für die Geometrie. Der Lizenztext besteht aus der GNU LGPL 2.1 und der „Open CASCADE exception 1.0“. Einige Quelldateien von OCCT enthalten kleine Teile anderer Urheber; deren Hinweise stehen am Ende des Lizenztextes.
note.en: HalfCube uses Open CASCADE Technology (OCCT) for its geometry. The licence text consists of the GNU LGPL 2.1 and the “Open CASCADE exception 1.0”. A few OCCT source files contain small parts by other authors; their notices are at the end of the licence text.

note.de: Die Lizenzdatei nennt keinen Inhaber; die Urheberzeilen stehen in den einzelnen Kopfdateien. Die Boost Software License verlangt den Hinweis nicht für Kopien, die nur in maschinenlesbarer Objektform vorliegen.
note.en: The licence file names no holder; the copyright lines are in the individual headers. The Boost Software License does not require the notice for copies that exist only as machine-executable object code.

note.de: Die Kopfdatei enthält außerdem Hedley-Makros von Evan Nemerson (MIT laut SPDX-Kopf) und, nur für Compiler vor C++14, eine Hilfsvorlage nach Google Abseil (Apache-2.0); HalfCube baut mit C++20 und übersetzt diesen Teil nicht.
note.en: The header also contains Hedley macros by Evan Nemerson (MIT per its SPDX header) and, for compilers before C++14 only, a helper template derived from Google Abseil (Apache-2.0); HalfCube builds with C++20 and does not compile that part.
